night: It is a shorter way for people who get along well to say "good night".
nice: If something is nice, it's good and people probably like it.

nine: (ordinal ninth) Nine is the number that is after eight and before ten. It can be written as 9.
Children study in school about nine months a year.
ninety-nine: (ordinal ninety-ninth) Ninety-nine (99) is the odd number that comes before one hundred.
Ninety-nine apples lay on the table.
ninety: (ordinal ninetieth) Ninety is an even number. In numerals, it is 90.
Ninety years ago, things were different.
Ninety is ten less than hundred and forty more than fifty.
nineteen: (ordinal nineteenth) Nineteen is the number that is after eighteen and before twenty. It can also be written as 19.

niece: A niece is the female child of someone's sister or brother and is a part of their extended family.
My brother has a daughter. She is my niece.
nirvana: When a person has reached nirvana, he no longer wants to have things.
When a person has reached nirvana, he is happy and at peace; enlightenment.

nigga: Another way to say nigger; it is often offensive, but is usually less offensive than nigger. Most often used by violent gangs.
nick: A nick is a small cut.

nigger: A very offensive and insulting name for a black person, sometimes used between black people themselves. It is more upsetting when used by people of other races (i.e. people who are not black).
Hey, nigger, what's up? (friendly if the speaker is black)

I love black people, but I hate niggers. —
